related.note: Same DMT laser 'code' phenomenon as telling 3, but Gallimore explains it as retinal laser speckle, not a code behind reality.

plain: The "code" some people report seeing when they shine a laser while on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, may come from laser speckle, the grainy pattern laser light makes on the retina. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore offers this to Michels as a reply to the claims of a man named Danny, whose experiments are said to reveal a code behind reality. Gallimore says the speckle acts "like a sensory scaffold" around which, under DMT, the brain builds complex forms.
